:::intro{robot="anatomy" title="Look closer, when you want to"}
This page takes the separator apart to show how design decisions become the parts you see. You don't need it to use the separator: [its own page](../separator) has everything you need to build.

**Three easy ways in**

- Start with the drawing. Each number is one part, and the legend beside it names it.
- Want to know why a part looks the way it does? Its card follows the decision from the answer about the product, through the rule and the token, to what you see.
- Or start from a job, like Focus or Emphasis, and find every part that does it in the legend.

Come back whenever a part makes you wonder why.
:::

## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/dense-data/separator/card-1.png" alt="Line: 1" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><b>Line</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What belongs together?">Grouping</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · What separates groups on the page? → Lines</div><div class="odv-am-why">Thin lines guide the eye along rows.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For between page sections, use space.gap.section and a hairline. Don't use a card around every section.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Lines separate without taking room from the data.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For items that belong together, use space.gap.tight. Don't use space.gap.group.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Things that belong together sit close.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>border-width.default</code><span>→</span><code>thickness</code><span class="odv-am-val">1px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> border-width.1</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.default</code><span>→</span><code>background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#DDE2EA · dark #3D4655</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.22:1, on surface.canvas). ## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `separator`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy dense-data separator`
